exports.n: Urea exports of Oman in customs data (7.63 Mt in 2024, CEPII BACI) are 178% of its production in the USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (2 Mt of nitrogen in 2024); urea exports converted to nitrogen with the nitrogen content of urea (0.4665, from molar masses), against ammonia production in nitrogen content. Declaration of cargoes of other origins under Oman is a plausible cause; it is not established here.

Customs data record 2.75 Mt of LPG from Oman to China in 2024 (86% of its recorded exports, CEPII BACI). The origin of these cargoes is not checked against an independent source: while Iran's exports are unrecorded, cargoes of other origins declared under Oman may account for part of this volume; it is not established here, and the atlas has no free source to measure it.

Oman is both an importer (rank 11, 12.8 Mt) and an exporter (rank 12, 13.2 Mt) of iron ore: ore may be transshipped, stored or blended there and shipped on, which counts the same ore in two countries' trade (a possible reading, not established here)
